title: Charging Stations and EV Charging Support
summary: This topic centers on EV charging use and support, with positive feedback about home charging fit and onboarding help, negative feedback about public station reliability and charging speed, and many fragments that mention charging context without clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise helpful guidance on EV setup and charging, along with battery range that reduces charging frequency.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on slow public charging, problematic charging stations, and concerns about broken station infrastructure.
